messageTemplate.notInWorkflow: Not in a workflow directory. Operation allowed.
messageTemplate.noStartCalled:
⚠️ Workflow Guard: You must call `advance.mjs start` before editing workflow content.

Run: node engine/advance.mjs start --dir <workflow-dir> --step <step-id>
messageTemplate.wrongArtifactLocation:
⚠️ Workflow Guard: Artifacts must be written to the workflow's artifacts/ directory.

Expected path: {workflow-dir}/artifacts/{step-artifact}
messageTemplate.gateNotCompleted:
⚠️ Workflow Guard: Cannot proceed to next step until Gate passes.

Run: node engine/gate.mjs result --dir <workflow-dir> --step <step-id> --result PASS|FAIL
messageTemplate.generalViolation:
⚠️ Workflow Guard: {message}

See docs/guard-system.md for help.
